sentences: Weighted all-pairs shortest paths requires every vertex to learn exact distances to all others in an edge-weighted network.
The 2017 source asks whether this can be done in a linear number of CONGEST communication rounds.
Straightforward repeated distance propagation is slower, while subquadratic algorithms suggest room for improvement.
The paper also shows that a standard two-party communication framework cannot establish a superlinear lower bound for this task.
The question therefore seeks either an algorithm coordinating many weighted searches within linear time or a different explanation of why their shared communication demands prevent it.
